## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), raw first, then 1/B spectra

Both field sweeps completed: run 6 at region-A n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D ≈ 0, B = 0→10 T (921 points, 120.4 min); run 7 at n = −1.2×10¹² cm⁻², D ≈ 0, B = 10→0.3 T (486 points, 95.7 min). Rxx below is the signed four-terminal ratio `(sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/−1e6)` from the TSV, with each channel kept separate. At run 6 the current was 9.84–9.94 nA, |Rxx| stayed below 530 Ω against the 5 kΩ full scale, and sample T was 1.165–1.292 K. Run 7 likewise stayed below 587 Ω; gate-current extrema were 123/117 pA (run 6, TG/BG) and 216/120 pA (run 7), below the 1 nA trip, with short charging transients included.

The first figure is the raw read. The second uses `sdh_fft` on signed Rxx, detrending in B before resampling to 1/B, for several B windows. It is a **spot-check preview**, not a stacking verdict: run 6 has a ~7 T peak with ~14–15, ~22–23 and ~29–30 T content. At B = 1–10 T (degree-3 background) the prominent peaks are 7.8, 14.4, 22.2 and 30.0 T; 7.8 + 22.2 ≈ 30.0 T, below geometry-prior F_L = 33.1 T by ~9%, while 14/22/30 also sit near harmonics of the low tone. Frequency drift with window and the harmonic/sum-tone ambiguity forbid classifying on this one column. The run-7 peaks near 4–7 and 12 T change with window; its D = 0 hole density is trapped in the model's close-pair exception regime. The electron side is the useful fan side: across density the harmonic multiples should track k×f exactly, while genuine pocket branches follow their own model F(n) curves. The run-6 low-frequency onset is reported as censored at the low-field record edge by `sdh_onset` (not a measured die-off), so the fan includes B = 0.8 T; its classification-grade FFT window must be chosen after the raw fan read.

from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

_sp = {}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    run = open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    B = run.col('magnet_field')
    R = run.col('sr1_X') / (run.col('sr0_X') / -1e6)
    _sp[rid] = (B, R)
    print(summarize_run(run))
    print(f'run {rid}: T {run.col("T_sample").min():.3f}–{run.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K, '
          f'|Rxx|max {np.max(np.abs(R)):.1f} ohm, '
          f'|I_tg/bg|max {np.max(np.abs(run.col("k_2400_tg_curr")))*1e12:.0f}/'
          f'{np.max(np.abs(run.col("k_2400_bg_curr")))*1e12:.0f} pA')
    ax[j].plot(B, R, '.', ms=1.5)
    ax[j].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='Rxx (ohm)', title=f'run {rid}: raw Rxx')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    B, R = _sp[rid]
    for lo, hi in ((0.8, 10), (1.0, 10), (1.5, 10)):
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), nfft=4096,
                       bg_degree=3, log=False)
        spec = s[0]
        ax[j].plot(f, spec / np.max(spec), label=f'{lo:g}–{hi:g} T')
        if lo == 1.0:
            peaks, _ = find_peaks(spec, prominence=.06 * np.max(spec))
            peaks = sorted((p for p in peaks if 3 < f[p] < 40),
                           key=lambda p: -spec[p])[:6]
            print(f'run {rid}, B=1–10 T, bg degree 3: '
                  + ', '.join(f'{f[p]:.1f} T' for p in peaks))
    ax[j].set(xlim=(0, 42), xlabel='frequency (T)', ylabel='normalized FFT magnitude',
              title=f'run {rid}: window stability')
    ax[j].legend()
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

_on = sdh_onset(np.abs(_sp[6][1]), _sp[6][0], r_full_scale=5000, b_lo=.3)
print('Run 6 onset diagnostic (censored low-field tone; use with the raw/spectral check):')
print(_on.summary())

## HERA — Step 4: electron D ≈ 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:25** · landau-fan-vti: region-A electron n=+2.40..+3.20e12 D=0, 22 paired-gate points x B=0.8..10 T 116 uniform-1/B rows, sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 2.4 s · **ETA ~08:50** (≈3h25m)

Runs 6–7 now have a raw-first analysis in ana cells 14–15. Run 6 at n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻² has a ~7 T peak plus 14–15, 22–23 and 29–30 T content; the latter could be harmonics, a second pocket, or a sum tone. Its ~7 T `sdh_onset` is censored at the 0.3 T record edge (not a measured die-off), while the ~22 T track begins near 1.33 T. Run 7 is strong but the available D = 0 hole window ends at −1.27×10¹², the close-pair exception regime. This fan follows the electron side so peak **slopes across n**, a single global density scale, and the Luttinger sum can separate those readings. A firming read will still need the investigation's dual 4L/3L overlays and F_L-tone-origin check.

The run-5 ridge-A calibration sets D = 0, c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 and the geometry-prior density scale. Paired gates sweep n = +2.40→+3.20×10¹² cm⁻² in 22 points (V_tg ≈ +0.754→+0.984 V; V_bg ≈ +0.870→+1.166 V), within the card limits. **Coverage trade:** the lower electron densities would enlarge the fan and enter the model's nearly empty light-pocket regime; the hole side lacks a high-|n| D = 0 range. Model ABAB light-pocket F = 4.79→7.31 T, heavy F = 20.03→25.78 T, versus ABCA F_L = 24.82→33.09 T. This window resolves the dominant-tone position as well as the candidate partner if its low-field track survives.

The field goes **0→0.8 T by a blocking bare ramp** (0.8/0.137 = 5.8 min) and then 0.8→10 T as 116 monotonic rows uniform in 1/B. The 9.2 T traverse floor is 67.2 min. Δ(1/B) = 0.0100 T⁻¹ gives 3.02 rows per period at F_L,max = 33.09 T; Δn = 0.0381×10¹² gives 2.03 points per g = 4 ray at 0.8 T. The full record has 1.15 T⁻¹ extent, δF = 0.87 T and ≥5.5 periods of the model's 4.79 T edge partner. If that partner turns on only above 0.8 T, its resolvability will be reported from the measured usable window rather than claimed from this design number. `fast_delay = 2.4 s` meets 8τ at the measured sr1 τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB; sr1 50 µV gives 5 kΩ full scale at the 10 nA drive. Run 6's 530 Ω maximum at n = 3.2, B = 10 T, scaled by 3.2/2.4 and allowed a further ×5 MR margin, gives ≈3.5 kΩ under that scale. Check the first rows for leakage, current, rail, T and field; revisit at B ≈ 2, 4, 6 and 8 T for a raw row and partial spectral read, and interrupt on a failed channel or sustained leak. Run 5's 1.172 s/point at 1 s fast delay implies ≈2.57 s/point here; 2552 points ≈109 min + 67 min traverse + 6 min positioning + row turnarounds and 10% contingency → about 3 h 25 min. The fan ends at 10 T with gates at the last n point, preserving the option to ride the field down in the next measurement.

# === Electron-side D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`), run-5 calibration ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Preconditions: read the state this cell assumes and does not set.
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live("T_vaporizer", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_vaporizer"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B, _Si = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_drive, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition T_sample={_Ts:.3f} K [1.0,1.5], T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (<1.6), "
      f"B={_B:+.4f} T (expect 0), V_si={_Si:+.3f} V (expect 0); "
      f"PS heater={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output={magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"heater ranges={heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()}")
print(f"drive={_drive:.3f} V ({_drive/100e6*1e9:.2f} nA), sr1 tau={_tau:.3f} s, slope={_slope} dB/oct; "
      f"gate NPLC TG/BG={k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()}")
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv-_Ts) < 0.6
assert abs(_B) < 0.03 and abs(_Si) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert abs(_drive-1.0) < .01 and abs(_tau-.3) < .001 and _slope == 24
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert (TG_MIN,TG_MAX,BG_MIN,BG_MAX,B_SESSION_CAP) == (-.3,1.0,-1.3,2.0,10.0)
assert (k_tg.volt.vals._min_value,k_tg.volt.vals._max_value) == (-.3,1.0)
assert (k_bg.volt.vals._min_value,k_bg.volt.vals._max_value) == (-1.3,2.0)
assert (magnet.field.vals._min_value,magnet.field.vals._max_value) == (-10.0,10.0)

CAL = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633, c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
           n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(2.4, 3.2, 22)   # density in 1e12 cm^-2, ascending
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)            # physical D = 0 V/nm, run-5 offset included
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'],
                                CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])
assert np.all((Vtgs >= TG_MIN) & (Vtgs <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((Vbgs >= BG_MIN) & (Vbgs <= BG_MAX))
_ncheck, _Dcheck = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'],
                           CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])
assert np.max(np.abs(_ncheck-ns)) < 1e-8 and np.max(np.abs(_Dcheck)) < 1e-8
B_start, B_end, N_B = 0.8, 10.0, 116
B_vec = 1.0/np.linspace(1.0/B_start, 1.0/B_end, N_B)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec[-1] <= B_SESSION_CAP
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1.0/B_vec))) < 1.0/(3.0*33.09)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY, I_TRIP = 2.4, 1.0, 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"fan grid: n={ns[0]:.2f}..{ns[-1]:.2f} ({len(ns)}), B={B_vec[0]:.2f}..{B_vec[-1]:.2f} ({len(B_vec)}), "
      f"D=0; TG={Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f} V, "
      f"BG={Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V; sr1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity():.0e} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc['Si (V)'] = _Si; mc['sample_temperature:'] = _Ts
mc['comments'] = (f"landau-fan-vti: region-A electron D=0, n={ns[0]:+.2f}..{ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 "
                  f"({len(ns)} points), B={B_start:.2f}..{B_end:.2f} T ({N_B} uniform-1/B rows), "
                  f"fast_delay={FAST_DELAY}s, sr1=50uV; run-5 calibration, runs 6/7 spot checks")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'region-A electron n {ns[0]:+.2f}..{ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D=0 V/nm; '
              f'B {B_start:.2f}..{B_end:.2f} T, {N_B} uniform-1/B rows x {len(ns)} paired-gate points; '
              f'cal run 5 c_bg/c_tg={CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n0={CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, '
              f'D0={CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; sr1 50uV, tau={_tau}s, fast_delay={FAST_DELAY}s')

# The blocking field set is the settle; 0 -> 0.8 T costs about 5.8 min.
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0]); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0])
s.ramp(magnet.field, B_start)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# Row layout: time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, I_tg, I_bg,
# sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P. Follow and plot every recorded channel.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot('time', sr0.X); s.plot('time', sr0.P)
s.plot('time', sr1.X); s.plot('time', sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X)

def fan_leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V, "
              f"Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f} V: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# Field and gates deliberately remain at the last row/point for the next step.
print(f"done: B={magnet.field():+.3f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V")

from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---

n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
